Anthropic-compatible Messages API through a gateway router. Set `model` to the router's name: the router picks one of its models, Emissary calls it with the router's provider key, and returns the provider's answer in Messages format. With `stream: true` the answer streams as server-sent events, as Anthropic streams them. If the picked model's provider fails, the router's default model serves instead.

With the Anthropic SDK, set the base URL to `https://api.withemissary.com/gateway` and the API key to your Emissary API key. For Claude Code, set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` to the same URL.
